To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The substitution relationship for the natural resources and the social resources is not significant in the production of grain, the elasticity of 4 factors increases with the year, the marginal output elasticity of technology is higher than other 3 kinds of factors, the elasticity of capital, labor and technology are all high, and the elasticity of sown acreage of grain is not significant
the elasticity of capital,literature,technology,sown of area of grain increases with the year, the elasticity of sown of area of grained is low, the elasticity of capital,technology is high.
the elasticity of 4 factors in grain production function increases with the years, and the elasticity of capital,labour, technology,sown area of the grain is all high.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the substitution relationship of the natural resource and social resources in grain production, which is helpful for the development of China's grain production.
the relationship between the grain production and the resource inputs,which is of great significance for the grain production capacity increase and grain security.
the substitution relationship between natural and social resources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the substitution relationship of food production between natural resources and social resource is not significant.
the grain production capacity of China is not only dependent on the sown area of grains,but also on the capital,technology,labor and so on.
the substitution of grain producing resources has been improved with the development of China's economy and the increase of the grain production level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sown area of grains has a positive effect on the production of grains,but the elasticity of sown areas of grain is not significant,so the substitution of sown area is not obvious.
the substitution relationship between natural resources and social resource is not only a theoretical problem, but also a practical problem.
the sown area of grains is not the only important factor to determine the output,while the capital, technology and labor are also important factors to improve the grain yield.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the substitution relationship between the natural resources of grain producing and social resources is very significant.
